Type: desk
Name: AmazonBasics 5-Level Adjustable/Portable Electronic Computer Workstation, Standing Desk Converter, Wood Surface - Black
Colors: Black
Portable desktop converter for changing between sitting and standing positions throughout the day Adjusts to 5 different height levels with simple electronic controls Can be set on a desk, table, or countertop to create instant height for the optimal work experience Sturdy steel frame with contemporary wood-finish table top; includes floor protectors to eliminate damage to base surfaces Convenient foldable design for easy storage and transport Quick, simple assembly with no tools required
